# GEMAS

Soil spectral library from the Geochemical Mapping of Agricultural and Grazing Land Soil (GEMAS), Europe

## Overview

- **Sample size:** 4,000+
- **Version:** first release (v1)
- **Spectral range:** mir
- **Extent:** continental

- **n properties available:** 12
- **n properties standardized:** 4
- **n properties harmonized:** pending
- **properties themes:** physical, chemical, carbon & nutrients, metal elements

## Soil site information

- **coordinates precision:** precise, country
- **sampling depth:** top
- **geography:** soil taxonomy
